data.description: Flora Isle: Seamless Architecture, Spectacular Views
data.long_description:
Flora Isle, located on the breathtaking Dubai Islands (Island A), offers a perfect fusion of luxury, comfort, and modern design. Developed by OCTA Properties in collaboration with Centurion Group and Flora Realty, the project features three impressive towers, each offering 1-3 bedroom apartments with panoramic sea views.

The innovative architectural design of the towers incorporates panoramic glazing and transparent balconies, enhancing the sense of openness and creating a light and airy atmosphere. Inside, every apartment is furnished with the highest quality materials and equipped with premium brands. Residents of Flora Isle benefit from exclusive access to a private beach, offering a serene escape.

The complex is also home to a wide range of amenities including a gym, jogging paths, landscaped recreation areas, a spa, and dedicated children’s play zones. With excellent transport links, Flora Isle residents can easily access key Dubai attractions, from shopping at Dubai Island Mall to visiting iconic landmarks like Burj Khalifa in under 40 minutes.
